question: In which of the following cities of India is the ‘Saptak Music Festival’ celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ahmedabad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Saptak Annual Festival of Music** is organized by the **Saptak School of Music.**
 
• It is an annual **13-day** Indian classical music festival held in **Ahmedabad, India.**
 
• This festival was started in** 1980 **by **Nandan Mehta** and his wife **Manju Mehta**.
 
• Besides pure classical music, it also includes the performance of **Folk Music, Classical Dance Forms, **and **Semi-Classical Dance Forms such as Thumri.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Notable festivals of other cities are as follows:**
 
• **Amritsar** - Lohri. Celebrated on the 13th of January every year.
 
• **Bhopal** - Bhopal Utsav Mela.
 
• **Lucknow **- Saifai Mahotsav
